description: This file defines the StreamDeliveryFailureEntity class used for representing delivery failure records in Azure Table Storage within Orleans streaming infrastructure, including methods for setting keys, serialization, and deserialization of stream sequence tokens.

classes.name: StreamDeliveryFailureEntity
classes.description: Represents a delivery failure record stored in Azure Table Storage for Orleans streaming failures, with properties and methods to manage keys and stream sequence tokens.

methods.name: SetPartitionKey
methods.description: Sets the PartitionKey property based on stream provider name and deployment id.

methods.name: MakeDefaultPartitionKey
methods.description: Generates a default partition key string using stream provider name and deployment id.

methods.name: SetRowkey
methods.description: Sets the RowKey property combining reverse order timestamp and a new GUID.

methods.name: SetSequenceToken
methods.description: Serializes a StreamSequenceToken into the SequenceToken byte array property.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Deserializes the byte array into a StreamSequenceToken object.

methods.name: ReverseOrderTimestampTicks
methods.description: Returns the number of ticks to order recent failures by most recent first, based on reversing the current UTC timestamp.
